SONGS OF THE WEST

FOLK SONGS OF DEVON AND CORNWALL

No. 1.  BY CHANCE IT WAS

[Music]

1
By chance it was I met my love;
It did me much surprise,
All in the merry month of May,
Beneath the moon-lit skies.

2
FIXTURE second stanza line one,
fixture second stanza line two,
fixture second stanza line three,
fixture second stanza line four.

No. 2.  THE TEST SONG

Arranged for the fixture.

1
Fixture song two verse one line,
fixture song two verse one more,
fixture song two verse one tail,
fixture song two verse one last.

NOTES ON THE SONGS

No. 1.—"By Chance It Was." Obtained of J. Woodrich, blacksmith.
